name: Idaho Spudcubing II 2021

venue.name: College of Eastern Idaho John E. Christofferson Multi-Purpose Complex

information:
# The registration payment glitch has been fixed. The new registration start time will be November 17th, 5 PM MST.

Please be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1veNWzPcM9sTuWmuBfvyzVbQxbvoNDuIZ-0w6SAyFbz4/edit?usp=sharing) for this competition.

Competitors may have at most one spectator.

Most competitors will be expected to be a judge or runner.
 Please look through the [Judging and Running](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSpudcubingII2021#16801-judging-and-running) and [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IdahoSpudcubingII2021#16800-competing) tabs before registering.
 
 Competitors are encouraged to bring their own pens.
